name: read_files
description:
Read up to 20 local files under read_file scope/privacy rules. Returns each path with content, totalLines and truncated, or error. max_lines_per_file limits text.

image_mode="native" without line parameters requests approved image pixels through the existing visual route; "text" forces extraction/OCR. Omitted mode follows privacy settings. PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF supported; GIF uses its first frame.

Without line parameters, PDF/DOCX/PPTX also provide originals to supported native routes when privacy permits. Office input is text-only; PDF can include images. Explicit line limits select extraction only; XLSX uses structured extraction.

paths.description: List of file paths to read (absolute or relative to a source root). Maximum 20 paths per call.

max_lines_per_file.description: Maximum number of lines returned per file. Default 500.

image_mode.description: native: approved image pixels; omit line parameters. text: extraction only. Omitted: follow privacy settings.
